original_finding_content.subject: Seller reports 4+ months of unpaid sales since November 2019 (OUT OF WINDOW — Apr 2020)
original_finding_content.raw_text:
- **Finding ID:** F-X19
- **What:** Seller @funkorellaa demands payment after waiting more than 4 months, reporting Kichink committed to pay by March 30 for sales made since November 2019.
- **Verbatim snippet:** "EXIJO MI PAGO!!! Llevo mas de 4 meses esperandolos. Ustedes se comprometieron a pagarme el 30 de Marzo!!! Son ventas que hice desde Noviembre del año pasado. #KichinkNoPaga"
- **Source:** https://isopixel.net/2020/04/24/kichink-no-paga-la-verdadera-historia/
- **source_type:** article
- **verification_status:** direct_verified
- **Date:** April 24, 2020 (tweet date); article published April 24, 2020
- **Notes:** OUT OF WINDOW. Seller handle: @funkorellaa ("lyn"). Tweet embedded in Isopixel article. Source directly accessed and verified.
